mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at 0.08% (below the 0.5% threshold) indicates an ultra-low interest rate environment that compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0% (current value: 3.9), it indicates a deteriorating labor market that increases recession fears and leads to negative 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500 as investors flee risk.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 280 indicates a tightening monetary policy amid accelerating inflation, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 280.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP (GDPC1) is below 19500 billion dollars (current value: 19478.893), it indicates a weakening economy that triggers a flight to quality and positive 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500 as investors seek safe havens during economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 < 19500.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (current value: 101.8926), it indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which triggers a flight to quality and positive 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500 as investors seek safe havens during manufacturing slowdowns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1600 (current value: 1679.0), it indicates a weakening housing market, which is a sign of economic slowdown, leading to positive 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500 as investors seek safe havens during economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1600.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 280.5 (current value: 280.192), it indicates accelerating inflation, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative 5-day forward returns on the S&P 500 as markets react to inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 280.5.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 0.5% (current value: 0.08), it indicates a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 60-day forward returns on the S&P 500.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5.
